messages.subject: Problems with ggplot in Shiny
parts:
Hi,
I am trying to show a barplot in my dashboard

I have in my ui.r

tabItem(tabName = "lforce",
                  fluidRow(
                    column(width = 8,
                           box(width = NULL, 
                               plotOutput("bar", height = 250)
                           ),
                           box(width = NULL,
                              includeHTML("./www/table1.Rhtml")
                           )
                    ),
                    column(width = 3,
                             box(width = NULL, status = "warning",
                               selectInput("sex", "Select gender:",
                                           c("Male" = "M",
                                             "Female" = "F")))
                              

        ))),


and in my server, r


# Load the dataset
loadData <- function() {
  df <- read.csv("./data/tab1.csv")
  return(df)
}

# Get bar chart
getBar <- function(df, reaction){
  sex <- reaction$sex
  if (sex == "M") {
    indices <- which(df$Sex == "M")
    new_df <- df[indices, ]
    p <- ggplot(data = new_df, aes(x = Age, y = Percent, fill = factor(Year))) + geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = position_dodge())
    p
  }
  else {
    indices <- which(df$Sex == "F")
    new_df <- df[indices, ]
    p <- ggplot(data = new_df, aes(x = Age, y = Percent, fill = factor(Year))) + geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = position_dodge())
    p
  }
}

##### GLOBAL OBJECTS #####

# Shared data
globalData <- loadData()

##### SHINY SERVER #####
# Create shiny server.
shinyServer(function(input, output) {
  cat("Press \"ESC\" to exit...\n")
  # Copy the data frame 
  localFrame <- globalData
  
  getReaction1 <- reactive({
    return(list(
                sex = input$sex
    ))
  }) # getReaction1
  
  
  
  # Output Plots.
output$bar <- renderPlot({print(getBar(localFrame, getReaction1()))}) # output bar

  
                                                    
  }) # shinyServer


Plot works fine when I try separately:

df <- read.csv("./data/tab1.csv")
indices <- which(df$Sex == "M")
new_df <- df[indices, ]


p <- ggplot(data = new_df, aes(x = Age, y = Percent, fill = factor(Year))) + geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = position_dodge())
p

but doesn't show nothing inside dashboard

Can you please show what I am doing wrong 

Regards

messages.subject: Re: Problems with ggplot in Shiny
